notes_for_editor: Do NOT use the 2025 'Visiting Volunteers' end-of-season report (firelookout.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/cr-cal-s-bm-2025.pdf), the 2026 Record-Courier article, or firelookouthost.org/bald-mountain: they concern a different Bald Mountain lookout on the Inyo NF (Mono County, built 1963). Build year is unresolved: register 1954, fire-lookouts.org and a 1955 Region 5 memo point to 1955; the story says so. Road date is unresolved (register: about a decade after 1954; fire-lookouts.org: 1967). The record's 2004 'restored' event (propane lighting, lightning protection repair, potable water, benches) was not found in any page read and is left out of the story; please verify or drop. The record's 1999 and 2001 registration events are both kept; the event notes explain the difference. height_m 12.2 converts the register's 40-foot tower; it is not stated whether that height runs to the cab floor. The cr-az-2009.pdf file is a multi-chapter FFLA compilation (first section is Arizona); the Bald Mountain passages are in its California sections, and one of them says Sierra National Forest where every other source says Sequoia. Staffing is 'seasonal' from the Forest Service page (manned, summer hours). The same PDF's 2009 Sequoia status list says Bald Mt was 'Staffed 5 days with USFS GS employee', which conflicts with the volunteer 'not staffed' entries; the story reports both and does not resolve it. The fire-lookouts.org page was last updated in 2013 and its staffing line is dated. No new photos added. Budget used: 6 distinct pages and 1 web search.
